ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Process Parents
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious parent processes that should not have any children or should only have a single possible child program

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\minesweeper\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winver\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$")) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\eventvwr\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wermgr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\win32calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "None"))
